description: Mark the always-present members of the repository-tag response definitions as required. Forgejo's Swagger is generated from Go structs with no `required` lists at all, so every response member types as optional and a caller has to defend against a repository without an `id` or a hook without an `url` — shapes Forgejo never produces: these fields are plain (non-pointer, non-omitempty) struct members serialized on every response. Only identity and timestamp members that every consumer needs are listed; genuinely optional data (descriptions, counters, nested trackers) and slices Go may serialize as `null` (`events`, `topics`) stay optional.
